content.name: Lena Hoffmann-Nguyen
content.title: Filialleiterin (Branch Manager), Public Pharmacy
content.summary: Licensed pharmacist (Approbation 2017) with nine years in public pharmacies in München, now running a branch with 11 staff and a specialist qualification in general pharmacy. I introduced paid pharmaceutical services in my branch, delivering more than 400 medication reviews for polypharmacy patients since 2023.

experience.title: Pharmazeutin im Praktikum (Pharmacist in Training)
bullets: Completed the 12-month practical year in a public pharmacy, dispensing and counselling under the supervision of the owner pharmacist.
Prepared 150+ individual compounded preparations a month in the pharmacy laboratory, following NRF formulas.
Prepared a case presentation for the accompanying practical-year seminar on interaction checks for patients taking direct oral anticoagulants.

experience.title: Approbierte Apothekerin (Pharmacist)
bullets: Advised 120–150 patients a day on prescriptions and self-medication in a city-centre pharmacy.
Took over the pharmacy's supply of care homes, managing weekly blister packs for 210 residents across three homes.
Ran the pharmacy's COVID-19 rapid testing station in 2021, testing up to 250 people a day and reporting positive results to the local health office.
Completed the three-year further training as Fachapothekerin für Allgemeinpharmazie with the Bayerische Landesapothekerkammer.

experience.title: Filialleiterin (Branch Manager)
bullets: Lead a branch team of 11 pharmacists, PTAs and PKAs with annual revenue of about €4.2 million.
Introduced pharmaceutical services (pDL) including extended medication reviews and blood pressure checks, delivering 400+ medication reviews since 2023, and added flu and COVID-19 vaccination.
Moved the branch smoothly to the E-Rezept, training the team and cutting rejected prescriptions to below 0.5%.
Lowered stock value by €65,000 while keeping availability above 96% by tightening ordering rules with wholesaler data.

education.degree: Fachapothekerin für Allgemeinpharmazie (specialist pharmacist, general pharmacy)

courses.name: Impfen in der Apotheke (Pharmacy vaccination training)

achievements.title: Approbation als Apothekerin
achievements.detail: Licensed to practise as a pharmacist in Germany since December 2017 after the third state examination.

achievements.title: Branch growth
achievements.detail: Branch revenue rose by 14% in three years without additional staff.
